assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site and key-area boundaries are PROVISIONAL (PROV-SITE-001 / PROV-KEY-001/002/003 from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson). They are used for design generation, visualization, and intake self-check only; official polygons must be substituted and all geometry/metrics recomputed when released.
assumptions.impact: Area values (site 11,412,825 sqm; key areas 3,692,893 sqm) match official announcement values within ~0.2% but are not official redline; professional scoring must use official geometry.

assumptions.statement: Transit connection nodes in geometry/roads.geojson (ROAD-006/007/008) are conceptual assumptions aligned with public facts: 昌平线学知园站轨道微中心（众智园）、五道口/清华东路西口轨道站点（AI原点社区，公告明确要求一体化设计）、大钟寺地铁站（公告明确要求一体化与四象限连通）。
assumptions.impact: Station interface geometry is provisional; exact station footprints and integration schemes await official rail plans.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints (216 features after de-duplication, 223,349 sqm) are concept-level design proposals in key areas, not statutory demolition/renovation/new-build conclusions and not existing-building inventory.
assumptions.impact: Any parcel-level construction scale conclusion is out of scope; missing existing-building baseline is recorded as a data gap.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards (S1-S10), event programs, investment and policy arrangements are conceptual suggestions or deepening directions for professional teams; none are stated as confirmed government arrangements, approvals, or implementation commitments.
assumptions.impact: The proposal remains within the agent open-call boundary clause (charter.3): open co-creation suggestions, not statutory planning.
